routing_reason: Existing Stripe Billing source update: full new raw + matched prior raw + current source; preserve version, UI variant, client/server, state and dated evidence boundaries; no semantic assumptions from collection diff alone.
findings: The same-URL November capture retains true pause as suspended service plus invoice generation, distinct from pause_collection and from automatic trial-end-without-payment-method status (new 7-20; old 10-19; source 13-21). Flexible billing is required and pause is immediate (new 24, 54-57); existing invoices still advance. Coupon duration continues during pause (new 18; old 44).

New capture documents API, Dashboard and configurable customer portal initiation plus a linked schedule route for future pause/resume attempts (new 24-36, 146-164). This directly conflicts with source 19, 50 and 73 and concept 16, 54 and 66; the linked schedule guide's detailed behavior is outside this capture.

New pause controls specify defaults and alternatives for bill_for unused licensed time, outstanding metered usage and invoicing_behavior (new 65-82). A pause invoice preview requires invoicing_behavior=invoice and billable amounts; otherwise 404, and preview does not mutate the subscription (new 115-138). Restricted keys need subscription_write and invoice_read for previews (new 20).

New resume payment_behavior branches are materially different: default resume_on_payment_attempt does not attempt collection in the resume request, failed payment leads to past_due, no automatic invoice retries and a 23-hour pending update expiry; recommended resume_on_payment_success can attempt with default payment method or sufficient cash balance, failure keeps paused, retries may occur, and expiry is one year (new 181-188). HTTP 200 alone does not establish active state; inspect status and pending_update (new 166-168).

New limitations refine the old trial-offer statement to active subscription-level free trials while explicitly allowing item-level trial offers, add unpaid status and distinguish attached subscription schedules from active billing schedules (new 307-321 versus old 33-42 and source 52-61). The old cadence term and reverse attachment rule are historical May evidence; the new page's omission does not prove removal or deprecation.
substantive_changes: Portal pausing, Dashboard flows, and linked scheduled future pause/resume attempt are newly documented, changing older manual-API-only and no-self-pause claims (new 24-36, 146-164; old 58, 62; source 19, 50, 73).

Pause and resume invoice preview conditions, non-mutating projected state, bill_for defaults, status_details pause reasons and transition timestamp, restricted-key permissions, and test-clock/Sigma examples add operational detail (new 20, 65-138, 190-203, 278-305).

Resume payment_behavior changes the payment attempt, failed status, retry and pending update expiry outcomes; May's manual-pay/23-hour/past_due prose only describes the November default branch, not all resume requests (new 166-188; old 66-73; source 76-82).

Eligibility table now limits the trial exclusion to subscription-level trials, expressly exempts item-level offers, adds unpaid, and names active billing schedules separately from attached subscription schedules (new 307-321; old 33-42).
conflicts: Source 50 and concept 54 say customer portal subscribers cannot self-pause, while new 26 explicitly says customers can be allowed to pause in the portal; update both with configuration qualification.

Source 73 and concept 66 say resume is manual only, while new 28 links scheduled resume attempts and new 146-164 gives Dashboard/API routes; distinguish scheduled attempt from guaranteed successful active state.

Source 78-82 and concept 75-79 generalize no payment attempt, past_due failure and 23-hour expiry; new 183-188 confines those outcomes to default resume_on_payment_attempt and gives a separate resume_on_payment_success path.

Source 56 and concept 29 exclude active trial offers generally; new 315 expressly exempts item-level trial offers. Source 57-61 and concept 30-33 omit unpaid and use cadence where new 316, 320-321 name unpaid and billing schedules.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve the May 13 old capture's preview Stripe-Version header, type=subscription request parameter and billing_cycle_anchor=unchanged example as dated examples (old 48-56, 83-89; source 39-46, 65-71); their absence from November examples does not prove these forms invalid, and a November pause API link carries api-version=2026-07-29.preview (new 40).

Preserve May's portal-display-only, manual resume, active-trial-offer, attached-cadence and reverse-attachment statements as attributed historical claims, not unqualified current rules (old 37-42, 58, 62; source 50-61, 73).

Retain the enduring distinction between true subscription pause, pause payment collection and system trial-end pause, along with coupon validity, existing-invoice advancement and the webhook/entitlement implications (old 10-30, 44, 91-123; new 7-20, 54-57, 205-243).
unresolved_questions: The linked schedule and customer portal guides are not part of this four-file same-URL review, so exact configuration, eligibility, and scheduled attempt outcome should be verified there before deeper claims.

November cURL omits the old preview header and type parameter while an API link is versioned 2026-07-29.preview (new 40-50); this capture alone does not establish endpoint GA status or whether old parameters are rejected.
The November table no longer uses the old cadence term or repeats the rule against attaching schedules/cadences while paused; omission alone cannot establish deprecation or reversal.
